decision_rule.hypothesis: Realism check for the scripted-seed machinery: agent-authored prior_sessions seed the same three-pool state the scripted seeds produce on the m4k0 twin cell (tax fixed mid-session -> resolved row; quota left failing -> open row; command ledger). If the memory-on delta under agent seeds lands near the scripted cell's -6% steps / +0.0 pass-rate anchors, scripted seed_commands are honest surrogates for prior_sessions and the ladder results stand. A materially different delta means the scripted path distorts what the measured agent sees — e.g. seed-authored variance in row headlines or scope binding — and the ladder's effect sizes are machinery-specific.
